verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's own MCP docs say it connects to external MCP servers and makes their tools available to its agents. Servers can be added from the Control UI, the CLI, or config, and the CLI manages saved MCP server definitions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP client connections work in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: an MCP server exposes tools, resources, and prompts, and OpenClaw connects to it and makes those tools available to your agents.
Connect MCP servers to OpenClaw from the Control UI, CLI, or config
